name: GPU cold plate, skived copper
summary: A direct-to-chip cold plate with skived copper micro-fins, for GPUs and accelerators up to 1.2 kW. Sample data: the supplier and every figure here are fictional.

buyers: Data center operators moving to direct liquid cooling
demand.reason: AI and high-performance racks now run hotter than air cooling can handle, so Indian data centers are moving to liquid cooling. The India data center cooling market is forecast to grow several times over by 2035.

sources.title: Liquid cooling for India's data centers, Energetica India
India data center cooling market outlook, Grand View Research
JLL India data centre 2026 mid-year report

specs.label: Thermal resistance
specs.tolerance: at most the stated value at 1.5 L/min

checked: Thermal resistance, power rating and pressure rating as stated by the supplier
notChecked: Thermal resistance, not measured by us

documents.title: Supplier cold plate drawing and pressure test procedure

evidence.summary: One production sample measured on our bench.
checked: Base flatness, mass and pressure drop on one sample
Leak test at 6 bar for 10 minutes
notChecked: More than one sample, so no batch spread
Thermal resistance under a real heat load

measurements.label: Base flatness
measurements.method: Dial gauge on a granite plate, nine points

measurements.label: Leak test
measurements.method: Air at 6 bar, 10 minutes, gauge and soap check

parts.name: Thermal interface material
parts.role: Fill the gap between chip and cold plate.
parts.whatItDoes: A thin layer of paste, phase-change pad or liquid metal between the chip lid and the cold plate base.
parts.whyItMatters: At a kilowatt per chip, a tenth of a millimetre of the wrong interface can cost more temperature than the whole cold plate.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask which interface material is specified and its thermal resistance
Ask for the mounting pressure the interface needs
Ask whether the interface is pre-applied

parts.name: Copper base
parts.role: Spread chip heat and carry it into the fins.
parts.whatItDoes: A machined copper plate, nickel plated, lapped flat where it meets the chip.
parts.whyItMatters: Flatness and copper purity set how evenly heat spreads. A base that bows under clamping leaves hot spots.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask for the flatness of the contact face in micrometres
Ask for the copper grade and plating thickness
Ask for the base thickness under the fins

parts.name: Skived micro-fins
parts.role: Give the coolant a large surface to take heat from.
parts.whatItDoes: Rows of very thin fins cut up from the base with a blade, so fins and base are one piece of copper.
parts.whyItMatters: Fin pitch trades heat transfer against pressure drop. Finer fins cool better but need cleaner coolant.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask for fin pitch and height
Ask for the filter rating the fins need in the coolant loop
Ask for pressure drop at your flow rate

parts.name: O-ring seal
parts.role: Keep coolant inside the cold plate.
parts.whatItDoes: A rubber seal in a groove between base and cover.
parts.whyItMatters: A leak inside a server is the failure buyers fear most. Seal material must suit the coolant and the temperature.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask for the seal material and its coolant compatibility
Ask for the pressure test procedure and result
Ask whether the plate is sealed by O-ring or by brazing

parts.name: Manifold cover
parts.whatItDoes: A machined cover with internal channels that feed coolant into the centre of the fins and collect it at the edges.
parts.whyItMatters: Channel design decides whether the hottest part of the chip gets the coldest coolant.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask for the maximum operating pressure
Ask for the burst pressure test result
Ask for the cover material and plating

parts.name: Inlet and outlet fittings
parts.role: Connect the cold plate to the coolant loop.
parts.whatItDoes: Two threaded brass or stainless fittings for the hoses or quick disconnects from the rack manifold.
parts.whyItMatters: Fittings and their threads are where most cold plate leaks start.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask for the thread standard and sealing method
Ask which quick disconnects the fittings are tested with
Check the inlet and outlet are marked

parts.name: Clamp screws and springs
parts.role: Press the cold plate onto the chip with the right force.
parts.whatItDoes: Spring-loaded captive screws at the corners that set the clamping pressure on the chip.
parts.whyItMatters: Too little force leaves an air gap. Too much can crack the chip or warp the board.
appliesTo: CPU servers with direct liquid cooling
buyingChecks: Ask for the clamping force and tightening sequence
Check the screw pattern matches your chip socket
Ask whether the screws are captive
